```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{TreeInsert}{$T,z$}
\State $y\gets\NIL$; $x\gets T.root$
\While{$x\ne\NIL$}
\State $y\gets x$
\If{$z.key=x.key$}\State\Return $\Duplicate$\EndIf
\If{$z.key&lt;x.key$}\State $x\gets x.left$\Else\State $x\gets x.right$\EndIf
\EndWhile
\State $z.parent\gets y$
\If{$y=\NIL$}\State $T.root\gets z$
\ElsIf{$z.key&lt;y.key$}\State $y.left\gets z$
\Else\State $y.right\gets z$\EndIf
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
